answer: Each epoch every claim must dock at the wharf, one berth per funding trail per tide, and the berth fee doubles for each extra berth from the same trail, so the k-th clone pays 2 to the k. The claim is then grafted onto the orchard, one graft per branch, and grafts grown from one rootstock share a single branch and split one harvest. A sprig of yarrow must be planted with each claim and takes a full epoch to root; a second claim from the same trail before it roots uproots the first, so clones queue in sequence while one honest agent docks once, grafts once, and keeps the whole harvest.
